review_scope: Independent static review of source-copy integrity, R1 remediation, split/cache exception, support-file checks, model/provenance bindings, receipt gate, and documented staging. No remote calls, full source hash, model/target-array loads, export, training, or repeated test suite were run.

source_inventory.local_verification: All 59 manifest source entries matched actual size/SHA; each copied baseline matched the frozen source snapshot; the package directory contained exactly those 59 files and no symlinks. The 4 support entries also matched size/SHA and exact inventory.

receipt_collision.evidence: The preflight calls os.path.lexists on the requested output after argument parsing and before sys.path modification or any wnn import. Final publication uses Path.open('x'), whose exclusive create rejects a path created during the preflight instead of overwriting it. Broken symlinks and existing paths are rejected by the early check.

support_file_runtime_seal.evidence: _verify_overlay_manifest invokes verify_f0_overlay_support_files against the exact four expected relative paths. The helper rejects unsafe/duplicate paths, missing files, symlinks, unexpected inventory, and size/SHA mismatches. The check runs immediately after loader import and again before receipt publication, so changes during the source scan are detected.

canonical_cache_source.evidence: The staged project's cache/chain_folds.npz must be a symlink whose literal target is the observed logical B path. That source must remain a symlink resolving to the pinned receipt target. The cache's full size and SHA are checked at preflight and inference load. The local observation receipt records the B-side read-only stat/resolve/full-hash method; reviewer did not make a remote call.

documentation_and_command.evidence: R2 defines WNN_PROJECT_ROOT, FROZEN_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT, PYTHON, and the staged manifest paths; specifies all inputs are staged before preflight; gives the exact cache symlink command; and documents that the frozen predictor deserializes the checkpoint before the split-loader receipt gate.

split_and_membership.result: The old split SHA is retained; the exception remains limited to cache/chain_folds.npz under that split and exact a112 identity. Ordered-membership and component-map evidence is pinned. The five other portable inputs still use the ordinary registry verifier and full-file/index checks.

checkpoint_and_provenance.result: Logical checkpoint/provenance paths must resolve strictly to the exact pinned B restore paths; both staged and restored paths are size/hash checked. No tensor or checkpoint load occurs in the preflight.

receipt_gate_and_resource_scope.receipt: R2 requires schema quality_gap.f0_compatibility_preflight.v2 and exact PASS_CPU_LOADER_PREFLIGHT status, old/canonical split hashes, membership and registry hashes, R2 overlay digest, exact cache source/resolved path and digest, exact artifact bindings, ordered membership digests, and loader checks.
receipt_gate_and_resource_scope.inference_order: The loader gate runs before model construction and inference. The unchanged predictor deserializes the checkpoint first; R2 README states this limitation explicitly.
receipt_gate_and_resource_scope.preflight_work: The preflight streams hashes for about 37.1 GB of portable source inputs, and reads the feature-only graph and fold cache to reconstruct components/evaluation membership. It does not load a model, prediction, or target array, grade, train, or initialize a GPU. No internal CPU/wall/memory cap exists; root must apply its external resource envelope.

root_owned_conditions.action: Before invoking the staged preflight script, root must independently verify that the B-side OVERLAY_MANIFEST_R2.json digest equals the reviewed digest in this report. After preflight, compare the receipt's overlay_manifest_sha256 to that same independently approved digest. The runtime code intentionally binds to the local manifest; that computed value is not independent approval.

Only after root's external hash approval, run the full portable-source verification under the reviewed resource envelope and inspect the resulting source, split, symlink, cache, provenance, and receipt bindings before any inference/export admission.

author_validation.reviewer_static_inventory_check: Passed; all source and support hashes/sizes and exact inventories matched the sealed R2 manifest.

decision: R2 resolves the R1 receipt overwrite, support-file seal, staging-order, undefined-environment, and canonical-cache-path findings. Approve R2 for root's externally hash-approved, bounded CPU preflight only. This is not approval of a completed preflight or any inference/export; those remain pending the checks above.
